hero.title: We are recruiting!
hero.body: We welcome engineers, makers, and storytellers who want to build the next generation of UAS. Applications open each September and January.

panel.title: RECRUITMENT
panel.body: We are currently recruiting for roles in aircraft, payload, software, and on our admin team. Scroll for more information on our team.

winter.label: Winter Recruitment Timeline
winter.note: NOTE: New openings for the January 2026 intake are limited in comparison to the September 2025 intake. Specific roles may not be available during this recruitment cycle, however we encourage applicants to apply if they meet the qualifications and are interested in joining the team. For those who don’t meet these qualifications, we recommend applying during the September 2026 recruitment cycle for a wider range of opportunities.
